PureDS4 managed dependency notices
=================================

This file covers managed NuGet assemblies bundled into the Windows x64
application. Versions below are checked against the published dependency graph.
The named authors and projects retain their respective copyrights. The
license texts below apply to the corresponding entries; this is not a change
to PureDS4's GPL license. Source and package locks are in the repository.

  H.NotifyIcon.Wpf/2.0.74 — havendv, Lakritzator, Philipp Sumi.
  MdXaml/1.27.0 — Copyright (c) 2010 Bevan Arps, 2020 whistyun.
  MdXaml.Plugins/1.27.0 — Copyright (c) 2022 whistyun.
  NAudio/2.2.1 — Copyright 2020 Mark Heath; Mark Heath and contributors.

  NAudio.Core/2.2.1 — Copyright Mark Heath 2023.
  NAudio.Midi/2.2.1 — Copyright Mark Heath 2023.
  NAudio.Wasapi/2.2.1 — Copyright Mark Heath 2023.

  DotNetProjects.Extended.Wpf.Toolkit/5.0.106 — DotNetProjects.

  XAMLMarkupExtensions/2.1.3 — Uwe Mayer, Konrad Mattheis, Bernhard Millauer.

System.Management has additional third-party notices in
ThirdParty/System.Management-THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt.

The self-contained Windows application also embeds Microsoft .NET and WPF
runtime components. Their license and third-party notices are distributed as
ThirdParty/DotNet-LICENSE.txt and ThirdParty/DotNet-THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt.
The exact .NET runtime pack's notices are also in
ThirdParty/DotNet-RuntimePack-THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt.
Microsoft's Windows-specific license breakdown is at
https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/license-information-windows.md .
Microsoft.Windows.SDK.NET.Ref/10.0.19041.57 supplies the unmodified
Microsoft.Windows.SDK.NET.dll and WinRT.Runtime.dll embedded in the application.
These Microsoft components retain their own Windows SDK terms; PureDS4's GPL
license does not relicense them. Terms: https://aka.ms/WinSDKLicenseURL .
The full offline agreement is ThirdParty/WindowsSdk-LICENSE.rtf. Standard
setup presents both Microsoft agreements separately from COPYING; portable
users must read PORTABLE-TERMS.txt before using the included components.
Their redistribution listing is at
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/legal/windows-sdk/redist#microsoftwindowssdknetref .
The WPF D3DCompiler_47_cor3.dll component also uses the Windows SDK terms,
as explained in Microsoft's Windows-specific .NET license breakdown above.
This notice identifies the applicable terms, not a claim that notice delivery
alone satisfies every distribution obligation.
